title.zh: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)
title.en: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)

current_state.zh: Cloudflare published a root-cause analysis of a Workers AI bug in which GLM-5.3's cross-request KV cache was not properly isolated between users, allowing potential overlap of session memory, traced to a prefill cache capacity mismatch and remediated by pulling the model from serving.
